Anthony Gordon.note: Gordon's edge is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Anthony Gordon.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Bukayo Saka.note: Saka's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Bukayo Saka.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在比防线早一步看到决定性的传球上。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Dan Burn.note: Burn's edge is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Dan Burn.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Dean Henderson.note: Watch Henderson for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Dean Henderson.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是提前站位后的快速反应。留意他如何判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Declan Rice.note: Rice's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Declan Rice.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Djed Spence.note: Watch Spence for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Djed Spence.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是防线暴露后的回追速度。留意他如何等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Eberechi Eze.note: Eze is defined by changing direction without losing control of the ball. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Eberechi Eze.noteZh: 他靠变向时仍把球控制在脚下与同位置球员拉开差异。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Elliot Anderson.note: Anderson stands out for creating a better angle for the next pass. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Elliot Anderson.noteZh: 他的突出特点是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Ezri Konsa.note: Konsa's signature is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Ezri Konsa.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位上。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Harry Kane.note: Kane's edge is making the next teammate's action easier. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Harry Kane.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是让队友下一步处理更轻松。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Ivan Toney.note: Toney's signature is giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Ivan Toney.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用上。他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

James Trafford.note: Watch Trafford for staying balanced until the shot reveals its direction. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
James Trafford.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在射门方向明确前保持身体平衡。留意他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Jarell Quansah.note: Quansah stands out for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Jarell Quansah.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

John Stones.note: Stones's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
John Stones.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Jordan Henderson.note: Henderson stands out for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Jordan Henderson.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在危险出现前组织好队友。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Jordan Pickford.note: Pickford is defined by turning a save into the first pass of an attack. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Jordan Pickford.noteZh: 他靠把一次扑救变成进攻第一传与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Jude Bellingham.note: Bellingham is defined by starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward.
Jude Bellingham.noteZh: 他靠在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。

Kobbie Mainoo.note: Mainoo is defined by keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Kobbie Mainoo.noteZh: 他靠压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定与同位置球员拉开差异。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Marc Guehi.note: Guéhi's signature is reading the next phase before the space fully opens. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Marc Guehi.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段上。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Marcus Rashford.note: Rashford's edge is explosive speed once open grass appears. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Marcus Rashford.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Morgan Rogers.note: Rogers stands out for using strength without slowing the next action. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Morgan Rogers.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Nico Oreilly.summary: Nico O'Reilly is an England midfielder from Manchester City who gives the national team midfield height, late box arrivals, and left-footed progression.
Nico Oreilly.note: O'Reilly's edge is creating a better angle for the next pass. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Nico Oreilly.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Noni Madueke.note: Watch Madueke for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Noni Madueke.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。留意他如何把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Ollie Watkins.note: Watkins stands out for starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Ollie Watkins.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Reece James.note: James is defined by delivering the ball without needing much space. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Reece James.noteZh: 他靠在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Trevoh Chalobah.note: Chalobah's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Trevoh Chalobah.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。
